COMMON FARE
Passengers with regular full fare mainland roundtrip tickets may travel
on Hawaiian Airlines to one or all of our island destinations for a charge
ot $9.00 (inc. tax) per stop.
To take advantage of this great vacation
bargain contact Hawaiian Airlines for more information and conditions.
CONNECTIONS AND STOPOVERS
Regular fare mainland passengers may connect directly to any island
without additional charge. On regular fare inter-island itineraries a
charge of $5.40 (inc. tax) will be made for each stopover. Definition of
a stopover: A stopover is an intentional interruption of a trip by a pas-
senger at a point or points between the city of departure and the furthest
outbound destination.
ADULT FARES
Round trip fare is twice one way tare.
CHILDREN'S FARES
Two years of age and under 12, half-fare. Under two years, free when
held by parent or guardian; half-fare when occupying reserved seat.
FAMILY PLAN FARES
Available every day of the week. Full fare ticket for one parent entitles
the other parent and all children 12 through 21 to reduced fare tickets
on all flights scheduled to depart Honolulu 11 a.m. and later, and on
all flights scheduled to depart neighbor islands until 2 p.m. and on
flights leaving Hilo until 4 p.m.
EARLY BIRD AND STARLIGHTER FARES
Reduced fares in effect between 12:01 a.m. and 6:30 a.m., seven days
a week, and from 8:00 p.m. to 12:00 p.m., every night except Fridays
and Sundays.
SENIOR CITIZEN FARES
Discount space-available to people 65 or over who buy $5.00 member-
ship card. Call any HAL office for details.
JET YOUTH PLAN
Discount available to those 12 through 21 years of age on a space-
available basis upon purchase of $3.00 identity card and proof of age.
Call any HAL office for complete details.
YOUTH GROUP FARES
Special fares are available to passengers under 20 years of age traveling
as a group of five or more, accompanied by an adult at least 20 years of
age. Applications and reservations must be made at least 7 days, and
tickets purchased at least 5 days, before travel. Call any HAL office
for complete details.
MILITARY STAND-BY FARES
Military discount to all service personnel on authorized leave on space-
available basis. Call any HAL office for complete details.
MILITARY R&R FARES
A special discount available to military personnel and their immediate
families on authorized R&R leave, positive space. Call any HAL office
for complete details and fares.
